topics.title: Vapor Pressure Deficit (VPD) & Microclimate Sensing
topics.objective: Calculate optimal plant transpiration rates by coupling air temperature, relative humidity, and leaf temperature.
topics.exercise: Write a microclimate calculator alerting growers when greenhouse VPD drifts outside the 0.8 - 1.2 kPa corridor.

topics.title: Automated Roof Vents, Evaporative Cooling & Shade Curtains
topics.objective: Regulate ambient temperature using PID controllers actuating ridge vents and wet pads.
topics.exercise: Implement a control loop coordinating shade screen deployment and roof vent opening during high solar radiation.

topics.title: Precision Hydroponic Dosing: EC & pH Telemetry
topics.objective: Automate nutrient delivery by continuously monitoring Electrical Conductivity (EC) and pH levels.
topics.exercise: Build a closed-loop fertigation controller maintaining nutrient solution between 1.8 - 2.2 mS/cm and pH 5.8 - 6.2.

topics.title: Supplemental LED Lighting & Daily Light Integral (DLI)
topics.objective: Optimize photosynthetic active radiation (PAR) to meet target daily light integral (mol/m²/day).
topics.exercise: Create an automated LED lighting scheduler adjusting light intensity based on real-time solar pyranometer data.

topics.title: Autonomous Emergency Override & Irrigation Failsafes
topics.objective: Protect crops from catastrophic loss with redundant power switching and pressure drop alarms.
topics.exercise: Design a safety interlock system that switches to emergency battery backup and closes storm vents on sensor failure.
